rolls.title: Stock
rolls.subtitle: Paper reels migrated from the previous system, with the shipment each arrived in. Cutting a reel records the piece against the roll it came from, so a remnant keeps its lineage.
rolls.newSubtitle: A reel of paper as it arrived. Remaining weight starts equal to the weight delivered.
rolls.detailSubtitle: Weights and state as recorded. A weight can only be corrected while nothing depends on the reel.
rolls.editSubtitle: Weights can only be corrected while nothing depends on the reel — no allocations, no splits, not consumed.

form.shipmentHint: Every reel arrived on a delivery. Not listed? <link>Record the shipment</link> first.
form.reelNumberHint: A label, not an identifier — reels may share a number.
form.weightsLocked: Weights are locked: {reasons}. Changing them would contradict records that already exist. Everything else about this reel is still editable.
form.lockAllocations: {count, plural, one {# allocation depends on it} other {# allocations depend on it}}
form.lockChildren: {count, plural, one {# reel was cut from it} other {# reels were cut from it}}
form.lockParent: it was cut from another reel
form.remainingHint: Remaining weight and length are set from the figures above — a reel that has just arrived is untouched.

detail.deleteBody: {name} will be permanently deleted. Nothing references it — no allocations, no reels cut from it — but this cannot be undone.
detail.restoreBody: {name} will appear in the default stock list again.
detail.archiveBody: {name} will be hidden from the default stock list. Its weights, allocations and split history are untouched.
detail.noAllocationsBody: All of it is free to cut.
detail.removeNote: Archiving keeps the reel and its lineage. Deleting is only possible while nothing depends on it.
detail.noteReserved: Part of this reel is held for an order. Only the free weight can be cut.
detail.noteRemnant: This reel is a remnant. Cutting it again records the new piece against the same parent roll.
detail.noteUntouched: Nothing depends on this reel, so its weight can still be corrected.
detail.lineageCutMeta: {count, plural, =0 {Recorded against this roll} one {# piece cut} other {# pieces cut}}
detail.lineageFreeMeta: What is left once the reservation is honoured
detail.lineageUntouchedMeta: Nothing has been cut from this reel yet

cut.title: Cut reel
cut.subtitle: A new reel of the chosen length is cut off; this one keeps the rest.
cut.childHint: The piece becomes its own reel, numbered after {reel}, with the same grade, width and provenance.

slit.title: Slit reel
slit.subtitle: Split the reel lengthwise into narrower bands. The reel is retired and each band becomes a reel.
slit.over: The bands add up to more than the reel's width
slit.motherHint: {reel} is {width} mm wide with {metres} m left. Each band gets the full length at its own width.
slit.noWidth: {reel} has no width recorded — enter it before slitting.

shipments.title: Paper shipments
shipments.subtitle: Deliveries of paper, from 2024 onward. The arrival date here is the real one — the rolls themselves were all loaded into the previous system on a single day.
shipments.newSubtitle: Record a delivery of paper. Attach its reels afterwards, from the shipment’s own page.
shipments.detailSubtitle: A delivery of paper and the reels that came with it.
shipments.editSubtitle: Blank fields stay blank rather than being stored as empty text.
shipments.deleteBody: {name} will be permanently deleted. It has no reels attached, so nothing loses its purchase history — but this cannot be undone.
shipments.archiveBody: {name} will be hidden from the default list. Its {count, plural, one {# reel stays} other {# reels stay}} attached and keep their purchase history.
shipments.restoreBody: {name} will appear in the list again.

form.supplierHint: Not in the list? <link>Add the supplier</link> first.
form.reelsDeclaredHint: From the packing list. It need not match how many reels are actually attached.
form.importFileHint: URLs only — the files live in someone else’s bucket and are not uploaded here.
form.attachedHint: {count, plural, one {# reel} other {# reels}} attached. Editing these details does not change them, and this shipment cannot be deleted while they are attached — archive it instead.

reels.emptyMessage: No reels on this shipment match that number.

receiving.title: Receiving
receiving.subtitle: Deliveries with reels still to scan in. A reel counts as stock once it has been scanned on the floor.
receiving.emptyText: Every reel on every active delivery has been scanned in.
receiving.scanSubtitle: Point the scanner at a reel label. The screen stays ready — there is no field to tap.
receiving.cameraUnsupported: This device has no built-in QR reader — use the handheld scanner.
receiving.shipmentArchived: This delivery is archived — restore it before receiving reels.
receiving.networkError: Could not reach the server — the scan was not recorded.
receiving.manualHint: Use this when a label is torn or will not read.
receiving.allInText: Nothing is left to scan on this delivery.
receiving.waitingDays: {count, plural, =0 {arrived today} one {waiting # day} other {waiting # days}}

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.subtitle: Walk the warehouse and scan every reel you find. Counting records what is there — it never changes stock.
stocktake.emptyText: Open one to start counting the reels on the floor.
stocktake.expectedNote: {expected} reels countable, {labelled} with a printed label
stocktake.closeConfirm: Close this stocktake? No more reels can be scanned into it.
stocktake.scanSubtitle: Every reel you find, in any order.
stocktake.notCountableHint: This reel is used up or archived, but it is on the floor.
stocktake.notALabel: That is not a reel label
stocktake.networkError: Server unreachable — the scan was not recorded.
stocktake.manualHint: Type or paste a reel code, then press Add.
stocktake.cameraUnsupported: This device has no barcode camera support.
stocktake.reportSubtitle: What was found, what was not, and what turned up unexpectedly.
stocktake.sideCountedText: Reels scanned and expected to be there.
stocktake.sideMissingText: Countable reels nobody scanned. Check these on the floor.
stocktake.sideUnexpectedText: Reels on the floor that the system had written off.
stocktake.unlabelledWarning: {count} countable reels have no printed label and cannot be scanned. Print them before counting.
stocktake.readOnly: This report is read-only. Correct stock from the reel's own page.

labels.title: Reel labels
labels.subtitle: One 10 × 10 cm label per sheet. The QR opens the reel; the text is for a reel whose code will not scan.
labels.sheetNote: Load 10 × 10 cm self-adhesive sheets, one label per sheet.
labels.missingParams: Nothing to print — open this from a shipment or a reel.

inks.title: Ink stock
inks.subtitle: The ink colours on the shelf and how much is left of each. Record a delivery with Restock, correct a balance after a count with Adjust; what an order uses is recorded from that order’s page and comes off the balance there.
inks.restockHint: A delivery. Added to the current balance of {stock} {unit}.
inks.adjustHint: A correction after a count. Replaces the current balance of {stock} {unit} — use Restock for a delivery.
inks.archiveBody: {code} will be hidden from the default list and cannot be drawn from until restored. Nothing is deleted — the orders that used it keep their lines, and its balance stays as it is.
inks.restoreBody: {code} will appear in the list and the usage picker again.

form.name: Name
form.balanceHint: Balance: {stock} {unit}. It is not edited here — use Restock for a delivery or Adjust after a count, from the list. The unit is fixed once the colour exists, since every figure on it is in that unit.
form.alertThresholdHint: Optional. The list flags the colour once its balance is at or under this figure.
